title: UPI hits record monthly volume — July 2026
summary: UPI processed **23.66 billion transactions worth ₹29.88 lakh Cr (₹29.88 trillion)** in July — its highest-ever monthly volume.

blocks.content: UPI processed **23.66 billion transactions worth ₹29.88 lakh Cr (₹29.88 trillion)** in July — its highest-ever monthly volume.

items: YoY: volume +22%, value +19% (one source cites MoM +4.1%/+3.3% vs June); PhonePe > Google Pay > Paytm; WhatsApp overtook CRED
